title: Coating compound found in the Bent Pyramid

tellings.quote: We've also found coating compound within the bent pyramid that would have protected the limestone walls from the vitriolic chemical reaction

plain: Inside the Bent Pyramid, an ancient Egyptian pyramid at Dahshur, a coating compound has been found that would have shielded the limestone walls from a harsh chemical reaction. The pyramid researcher Geoffrey Drumm says "we've" found it, speaking as one involved, and offers it as evidence that the pyramids were used for chemical processes.
